# UILabelComponent

*Client* · extends [`UIComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UIComponent)

Single-line text of a script UI with a color, shadow, background and anchor.

## Methods

### getLabel {#getlabel}

::: member

**Returns** [`String`](/scripting/js/String) — text of the label

:::

### getColor {#getcolor}

::: member

**Returns** [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) — text color, as `0xAARRGGBB`

:::

### isTextShadow {#istextshadow}

::: member

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — whether the text has a shadow

:::

### getLabelAnchor {#getlabelanchor}

::: member

**Returns** [`ScriptVector`](/scripting/common/ScriptVector) — new vector with the text anchor: x along the width, y along the height, z is 0

:::

### getLabelAnchorX {#getlabelanchorx}

::: member

**Returns** [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) — horizontal text anchor: 0 left, 0.5 center, 1 right

:::

### getLabelAnchorY {#getlabelanchory}

::: member

**Returns** [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) — vertical text anchor: 0 top, 0.5 center, 1 bottom

:::

### labelAnchor {#labelanchor}

::: member

Aligns the text inside the label's area.

```js
ui.label("Centered").rw(1).h(20).labelAnchor(0.5, 0.5);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | 0 left, 0.5 center, 1 right |
| `y` | [`float`](/scripting/js/Number) | 0 top, 0.5 center, 1 bottom |

**Returns** [`UILabelComponent`](/scripting/client/ui/components/UILabelComponent) — this label

:::

### getBackgroundColor {#getbackgroundcolor}

::: member

**Returns** [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) — background color as `0xAARRGGBB`; 0 means no background

:::

### label {#label}

::: member

| `label` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | new text |

::: member

| `color` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | color as `0xRRGGBB` or `0xAARRGGBB` |

:::
